name: Exaltation of Christ

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Eternal Counsel of the Godhead

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state of the Word before the incarnation event.

TANCH.justification: The final state where God is all in all, closing the economy of salvation.

AFWD.justification: The upward movement of the glorified humanity into the celestial sanctuary.

AREV.justification: The descent of the divine into the material and mortal condition.

CLINK.justification: The sequential linking of the roles of Prophet, Priest, and King.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-existent identity that remains constant through all transitions.

FSPLIT.justification: The point where the person of Christ enters the divergence of death and life.

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of the separated soul and body into a glorified whole.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative verdict of the Father regarding the finished work.

EVALF.justification: The negative judgment executed upon the flesh in the passion.

ENGAGR.justification: The state of being simultaneously dead in the flesh and alive in the spirit.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible enthronement of the God-man.

phase_3.void_description: The silence before the creative utterance of the Logos.
phase_3.true_description: The glorification and acceptance of the Son by the Father.
phase_3.false_description: The rejection and suffering experienced in the state of humiliation.
phase_3.both_description: The hypostatic union where divinity and humanity coexist in one person.

steps.domain_action: The Logos exists in eternal relation with the Father.
The Logos identifies as the self-existent source of life.
The Logos descends into the womb of the Virgin through kenosis.
The divine nature composes with human nature in the hypostatic union.
The person of Christ enters the passion, splitting the experience of the soul and body.
The F-arm carries the weight of the curse and the reality of physical death.
In the tomb, Christ holds the state of being dead yet remaining the Lord of life.
The T-arm carries the merit of perfect obedience and the power of an indestructible life.
The Resurrection reunites the body and soul into a singular glorified identity.
The glorified Christ ascends to the heavenly places.
Christ sits at the right hand of the Father as a permanent high priest.
The exaltation reaches its terminal state in the subjection of all enemies.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit who effects the transitions between states.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The communicatio idiomatum between the two natures.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Holy Scriptures and the Apostolic Tradition.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The fullness of time as determined by the Father.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The kenotic emptying of the divine prerogative.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The glory the Son had with the Father before the world began.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The same glory now shared with a redeemed humanity.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The process is a closed cycle of descent and ascent that restores the original glory.
